# Module: `icescopy_temperature_refresh`

Retains temperature-import inputs so freeze counts can be rebuilt after session edits.

[Source](../src/icescopy_temperature_refresh.py) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

Encodes parsed input records, arrays, and timestamps into session-compatible values. A refresh context records the importer, options, and frame identity. Rebuilding checks that the same frames remain in the same order, then calls the matching standard, .dat, TAMU, or PKU count builder.
